meta.title: Duplicate or Delete a column from Column settings

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen for the RFQ pricing event.
Provide the required event title before configuring and inspecting the sheet.
Use an RFQ pricing stage so the template-backed column sheet is available.
Apply the first available RFQ template, which supplies the initial column.
Add a line item so the pricing sheet renders.
Populate the pricing sheet before testing its column controls.

args.goal: On the RFQ pricing sheet, record the current number of columns, open the three-dots menu next to Column settings, choose Duplicate, and verify on the sheet that the column count increased by exactly one. Then open the three-dots menu for a column, choose Delete, and verify that the column count decreased by exactly one; stop on the pricing sheet showing the resulting columns.

steps.note: Perform and visually verify the column duplication and deletion behavior, including both count changes.
Assert that the pricing sheet remains rendered with at least one column after the operations.
